title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler mit scharfer Schusswaffe unterwegs – Haftbefehl erlassen

extraction.summaryEn: Police observed a 28-year-old allegedly selling drugs at S-Bahnhof Tempelhof, then arrested him at S-Bahnhof Hermannstraße. He was carrying a real firearm, ammunition, drugs and a knife, and an arrest warrant was issued.
